name: Penarddun

attributes.attribute: daughter of Don and Beli, consort of Llyr
mother of Branwen and of the sons Bran the Blessed and Manawydan

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Penarddun is a Welsh heroine. She was the daughter of the great goddess Don and the sea god Beli. She was one of the consorts of King Llyr. Some say she was the mother of Branwen and of the sons Bran and Manawydan. With the man Eurosswyd she bore two sons of opposing temper: the gentle Nisien and the evil Efnisien. All of her children appear in the Welsh tales of the Mabinogion. She herself has little legend, and looks ancestral.

okr.objective: Introduce Penarddun as a Welsh ancestral heroine.
